anchor.exact: "Looks like a copy, is a copy" moves the cost of field reads.

messages.author: agent:claude-sos-reviewer
messages.body: sawos can supply the measurement this item says is missing, for free. Every sawos gate transcript prints the size of every image it links (kernel ELF payloads and each .sosimg). The tracker server runs that gate on every SO patch, pinned by sha (SO-20), so the kernel migration's patch-vs-base transcript diff IS the size cost of turning the 410 G2 reads into getitem copies, per image. Size is the scarce resource on sawos targets: -Oz everywhere, and the ESP32-C3 board runs from 400 KiB of SRAM. So if the diff shows growth, the rewrite should be borrow let rather than getitem, and the diff will say which images it hits. Whether -Oz folds a whole-slot copy followed by a one-field read down to a single load is exactly what that diff would answer, with no benchmark to write.
